objectives: Introduce students to the impossible project of piecing together the History of Western Civilization.  Shockingly illogical, sprawlingly vast, intrusively brutal.  If you were alive and weren't white, they wanted you dead or enslaved.  Nobody used to ask, what is Western Civilization.  They just shivered. Then Steve Jobs came along and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
content: Looking at history from King Arthur to Dracula, both bound to live again, likely the same person, though some have spotted DNA traces of Arthur in Frankenstein, and Oppenheimer.  DNA testing has opened a whole new world of Historical Research.
grading_policy: Writing every week.  Midterm and Final Paper.
